_comment: The showcase: invented characters (generated, never real people) and the takes rendered with them. Run `openfield showcase --dry-run` to see the plan, then `openfield showcase` against a real backend. The re-shoot source is a short clip filmed for this project: put it at showcase/assets/source.mp4.

takes.name: mara-market-dolly-in

takes.audio: rain on awnings, distant chatter, a bicycle bell

takes.name: mara-rooftop-crane-up
takes.subject: Mara stands on a rooftop at sunrise and looks out over the city, wind in her jacket

takes.name: oskar-pier-orbit
takes.subject: Oskar mends a fishing net on a harbour pier at golden hour
takes.audio: water lapping against wood, creaking boats, gulls

takes.name: oskar-closeup-static
takes.subject: A close-up of Oskar's face in the cold morning, his breath visible, a faint smile
takes.audio: soft wind, a distant bell buoy

takes.name: ines-canal-track
takes.subject: Ines walks along a canal bridge playing a small accordion, autumn leaves on the stones
takes.audio: a gentle accordion melody, footsteps on stone

takes.name: ines-cafe-arc
takes.subject: Ines writes in a notebook at a cafe window while rain runs down the glass
takes.audio: cafe chatter, rain on glass, a spoon against a cup

takes.name: thermos-orbit
takes.subject: A matte black ceramic thermos with a copper lid on a wet slate surface, a thin curl of steam rising

takes.name: thermos-dolly-out
takes.subject: The same matte black ceramic thermos with a copper lid on a wet slate surface, steam rising, a pine forest in soft focus behind
takes.audio: quiet forest air, a faint steam hiss

takes.name: lighthouse-zoom
takes.subject: A white lighthouse on a cliff at dusk, waves breaking on the rocks below, the lamp just switching on
takes.audio: waves crashing, wind, a low foghorn

takes.name: harbour-dolly-out
takes.subject: Fishing boats moored in a small harbour at first light, mist over the water
takes.audio: gulls, water against hulls, rope creaking
